title: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether MG, LFCR, MGLD are Obtaining Fair Deals for their Shareholders
author: Halper Sadeh Llc
description: Halper Sadeh LLC, an investor rights law firm, is investigating three companies for potential securities law violations and breaches of fiduciary duties related to their proposed acquisitions. The firm is examining whether MISTRAS Group's $20.35/share sale to H.I.G. Capital, Lifecore Biomedical's $6.28/share sale to Webster Equity Partners, and Marygold Companies' $2.00/share sale to Madison Dearborn Partners represent fair deals for shareholders. The firm may seek increased consideration, additional disclosures, and other relief on behalf of shareholders.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is under investigation for potential securities law violations and breach of fiduciary duties regarding its acquisition at $20.35 per share, suggesting shareholders may not be receiving fair consideration.

Company is under investigation for potential securities law violations and breach of fiduciary duties regarding its acquisition at $6.28 per share plus contingent value rights, raising concerns about fair dealing for shareholders.

Company is under investigation for potential securities law violations and breach of fiduciary duties regarding its acquisition at $2.00 per share, suggesting the deal may not be fair to shareholders.

title: Pomerantz LLP and The Rosen Law Firm, P.A. Announce Proposed Class Action Settlement on Behalf of Purchasers of Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. Securities - LFCR
author: Na
description: A proposed class action settlement of $3,750,000 has been reached on behalf of purchasers of Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. (NASDAQ: LFCR) securities between October 7, 2020, and March 19, 2024. The settlement requires court approval at a hearing scheduled for July 28, 2026. Class members must submit claim forms by July 7, 2026, to be eligible for distribution from the settlement fund.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is the defendant in a class action lawsuit involving alleged securities fraud during the period October 2020 to March 2024. The settlement of $3.75 million indicates legal liability and potential misconduct by company leadership, which is negative for shareholders and the company's reputation.

title: Lifecore Biomedical Signs Commercial Site Transfer Agreement with Leading Medical Aesthetics Company
author: Na
description: Lifecore Biomedical announced it has signed a CDMO manufacturing services agreement with a new aesthetics customer for an established, market-approved product. This is the company's third commercial site transfer since October 2025. The product is expected to generate commercial revenue within 24 months and contribute to Lifecore's targeted 2029 revenue CAGR of 12%. The agreement demonstrates successful execution of the company's strategy to secure lower-risk, late-stage programs with faster paths to commercial revenue.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company secured its third commercial site transfer in five months, demonstrating strong execution of its strategic plan. The agreement is expected to generate revenue within 24 months and contribute to the company's 12% 2029 revenue CAGR target. Management expressed confidence in leveraging market momentum and building a stronger growth portfolio. This represents successful business development and validates the company's shift toward lower-risk, late-stage programs.

title: Lifecore Biomedical Shareholders Are Encouraged to Reach Out to Johnson Fistel for More Information About Potentially Recovering Their Losses
author: Johnson Fistel, Pllp
description: Johnson Fistel, PLLP announced investigations into three companies on March 16, 2026. Lifecore Biomedical issued disappointing 2026 revenue guidance of $120-125 million versus $141.4 million in 2025, citing customer loss and product launch delays, resulting in an 18% stock decline. The firm is also investigating Horizon Technology Finance and G-III Apparel Group for potential federal securities law violations.
